London Mayor Orders Council to Halt Pub Ban in Soho and West End

London Mayor Sadiq Khan has directed Westminster council to abandon a proposed policy that would have prohibited the opening of new pubs and bars in the Soho and West End areas. Khan urged the council to pursue a 'positive vision of economic growth' for the city's nightlife. The directive follows reporting by The Guardian that revealed the council's initial plan. The Evening Standard described the situation as a 'furious row' between Khan and Westminster Tories over licensing rules.
